name: @kwala-ai/mcp

tools.name: kwala-create-automation
tools.description: Generate a complete, deployable Kwalang YAML workflow from structured parameters. This is the flagship tool — it auto-fetches ABIs, resolves token addresses, and builds the full workflow. The resulting YAML can be passed directly to kwala-verify-workflow and kwala-deploy-workflow.

description.description: Natural language description of what the automation does.

contract_address.description: Contract or address to watch (for event/address_tracking triggers). Can use token name like 'USDC' which auto-resolves.

chain.description: Chain name or ID (e.g., 'Base', 'Ethereum', '84532'). Default: Base Sepolia.

event_name.description: Event name (e.g., 'Transfer'). Auto-resolved to full signature from ABI.

interval_seconds.description: Repeat interval in seconds (for time triggers).

expires_in.description: Expiration in seconds or Unix timestamp.

actions.description: Array of actions (1-10). Each action can be a contract call, notification, or API call.

testnet.description: Use testnet chain IDs. Default: true.

tools.name: kwala-explain-yaml
tools.description: Explain a Kwalang YAML workflow in plain English. Accepts raw YAML or a workflow ID to fetch and explain.

workflow_id.description: Workflow ID to fetch and explain. Accepts original name or full ID.

tools.name: kwala-list-templates
tools.description: Browse pre-built Kwalang workflow templates. Filter by category or search by keyword.

tools.name: kwala-build-trigger
tools.description: Generate a Kwalang Trigger YAML section from structured parameters. Auto-fetches ABIs and resolves event signatures — you never need to handle base64 or full signatures manually.

contract_address.description: Contract or address to watch (required for event and address_tracking).

chain.description: Chain name or ID (e.g., 'Base', '8453'). Default: Base Sepolia.

event_name.description: Event name (e.g., 'Transfer'). Auto-resolved to full signature from ABI.

interval_seconds.description: Repeat interval in seconds (for time type).

block_number.description: Block number to trigger at (for block type).

expires_in.description: Expiration: seconds as string or Unix timestamp.

abi_json.description: Raw ABI JSON string. Only needed if the contract is unverified and auto-fetch fails.

tools.name: kwala-build-action
tools.description: Generate a Kwalang Action YAML block. Supports contract calls, notifications (Telegram/Discord/webhook), and API calls. Auto-resolves function signatures from ABIs.

type.description: Action type: call (contract), notification (Telegram/Discord/webhook), api (raw POST), deploy (contract deployment).

function_name.description: Function name (e.g., 'transfer'). Auto-resolved to full signature from ABI.

params.description: Function parameters. Use 're.event(N)' for dynamic values.

chain.description: Chain name or ID. Default: Base Sepolia.

webhook_url.description: Webhook URL (for discord or webhook channel).

message.description: Message template. Use re.event(N) for dynamic data.

tools.name: kwala-verify-workflow
tools.description: Verify a Kwalang YAML workflow against Kwala's backend API. This is the same compilation step the Kwala dashboard uses. If valid, the workflow is deployable.

yaml.description: The Kwalang YAML workflow to verify.

tools.name: kwala-deploy-workflow
tools.description: Deploy a Kwalang YAML workflow end-to-end on the KWALA chain. Verifies first, then performs on-chain transactions: save -> deploy -> activate. Returns step-by-step progress with transaction hashes.

yaml.description: The Kwalang YAML workflow to deploy (should be verified first via kwala-verify-workflow).

auto_activate.description: Activate immediately after deploying. Default: true.

tools.name: kwala-prepare-deploy
tools.description: Prepare unsigned transactions for deploying a workflow. Returns encoded calldata that a browser wallet (MetaMask) can sign and broadcast. Use this instead of kwala-deploy-workflow when the user has a connected wallet in the UI.

yaml.description: The Kwalang YAML workflow to deploy.

user_address.description: The connected wallet address that will sign the transactions.

tools.name: kwala-deactivate-workflow
tools.description: Stop one or all running workflows. Pass a workflow_id to stop one, or set deactivate_all=true to stop everything. Lists active workflows first so user can choose. Cannot be undone — deploy a new workflow instead.

workflow_id.description: Workflow ID or name to stop. Omit if using deactivate_all.

deactivate_all.description: Set to true to stop ALL your deployed workflows at once.

list_active.description: Set to true to list active workflows before deactivating. Useful to let the user choose.

tools.name: kwala-workflow-status
tools.description: Check the deployment and execution status of a workflow. Accepts the original workflow name (auto-appends your wallet address) or the full workflow_id.

workflow_id.description: Workflow ID (e.g., 'MyWorkflow_0xABC') or just the name (e.g., 'MyWorkflow').

tools.name: kwala-list-workflows
tools.description: List all workflows deployed by a wallet address. Uses your stored wallet by default.

address.description: Wallet address. Uses your stored wallet if omitted.

tools.name: kwala-explorer-stats
tools.description: Get live network-wide statistics from the Kwala Explorer: total action executions, deployed workflows, and optional per-user or per-workflow filtering.

user_address.description: Filter stats by a specific wallet address.

workflow_name.description: Filter stats by a specific workflow name.

tools.name: kwala-explorer-actions
tools.description: Browse recent workflow action executions from the Kwala Explorer. Paginated, optionally filtered by user address.

tools.name: kwala-get-workflow
tools.description: Fetch the full YAML definition of a deployed workflow by its ID. Accepts the original workflow name (auto-appends your wallet address) or the full workflow_id.

workflow_id.description: Workflow ID (e.g., 'MyWorkflow_0xABC') or just the name (e.g., 'MyWorkflow').

tools.name: kwala-fetch-abi
tools.description: Fetch the ABI for any smart contract on any Kwala-supported chain. Returns the ABI as JSON with a list of all events and functions. Accepts chain name (e.g., 'Base') or chain ID.

tools.name: kwala-wallet
tools.description: Show your KWALA chain wallet address. Creates a new wallet automatically if none exists. This wallet is used to deploy workflows on-chain.

tools.name: kwala-credit-balance
tools.description: Check Kwala credit balance. Credits are consumed when workflows execute. Uses your stored wallet address by default.

address.description: Wallet address. Uses your stored wallet if omitted.

tools.name: kwala-configure
tools.description: View or update your Kwala notification settings. Store Telegram bot token, Discord webhook, and default chain so they auto-populate in all workflows. Call with no params to see current config.

telegram_chat_id.description: Telegram chat ID where notifications are sent.

tools.name: kwala-login
tools.description: Authenticate with Kwala via Google OAuth to enable workflow activation. Opens Google login in the browser — after login, Kwala returns a JWT token. Pass the token back here to store it. Required for full workflow deployment.

jwt.description: JWT token from Kwala after Google OAuth login.

tools.name: kwala-tools
tools.description: Returns a categorized list of all 20 MCP tools available in Kwala AI.

tools.name: kwala-list-chains
tools.description: List all blockchain networks supported by Kwala. Includes chain IDs, symbols, and well-known token addresses per chain.

network.description: Filter by network type. Default: all
